info.title: Kiorly Lab Integration API (draft)
info.description: DRAFT (x-status: draft). Inbound order API of Kiorly Lab (kiorly-lab apps/api src/integration), mirrored from the code and Docs/NEEDS_HUMAN.md NH-LB-025; not frozen until the lab owner approves (NH-LB-023). Callers are Kiorex (KIOREX_BOOKING) and Kiorly Clinic lab-order handoff (KIORLY_CLINIC); the client's source is bound to its key. Outbound events are the Lab* schemas in events/. Requests are signed with the Kiorly HMAC scheme; no tax-authority reporting exists. 1.4.0: catalogue, quote and slots endpoints for the Kiorex marketplace (additive); the client key binds the tenant (no org header); outbox events go to Kiorex /api/v1/webhooks/lab signed with the webhook scheme + X-Kiorly-Client-Key. 0.3.0 (contracts 1.6.0): ratified Nurse-edition additions (KNLAB01/KLORD05): third client source KIORLY_NURSE (Kiorly Nurse is an edition of Kiorly Clinic, ADR-031; Kiorex holds the registration and relays), optional `nurseCollection`, `identifiersChecked` and `collection.districtId` on the inbound order, and the custody read `GET /integration/v1/orders/{sourceRef}/custody`. 0.4.0 / 1.8.0 (additive): optional Arabic test names and preparation text (nameAr, preparationAr, sampleTypeAr) on GET /tests and POST /tests/quote. 1.13.0 (additive): signed `POST /integration/v1/commission-rates` (COM-2: the lab's commission rate view; the lab only displays it).

post.summary: Create (idempotent on sourceRef) a lab order from Kiorex, Kiorly Clinic or Kiorly Nurse
post.description: Replaying the same `sourceRef` for the same client returns the existing order with `created: false`. Unknown fields are rejected (strict). Flag lab.kiorex_bookings gates KIOREX_BOOKING orders. KIORLY_NURSE clients submit only nurse-collected orders (400 NURSE_COLLECTION_REQUIRED without `nurseCollection`; 400 NURSE_ORDER_CANNOT_BE_HOME_COLLECTION). Refusals for nurse orders: 400/422 CONSENT_REQUIRED, 422 TWO_IDENTIFIERS_REQUIRED, COLLECTED_IN_FUTURE, HANDOVER_TIME_INVALID, SAMPLE_MISSING_FOR_TEST, SAMPLE_UNMATCHED, SAMPLE_DUPLICATE_GROUP, 409 ACCESSION_DUPLICATE (the whole ingest rolls back).

districtId.description: Coarse district code for HOME collections (coverage check); never a full address in events.

consentChannels.description: Result-release consent; with none recorded nothing is released on any channel.

identifiersChecked.description: KLORD05: kinds of the >= 2 DISTINCT identifiers the nurse verified at collection, each present on the order's patient (fullName is accepted for KIORLY_NURSE intake only; the doorstep/desk flows keep dateOfBirth, phone, nationalId, externalId). Kinds only, never the values.

InboundLabOrder.description: Strict inbound order (unknown fields are rejected). `nurseCollection` is accepted only from a KIORLY_NURSE client (and is required from it); `identifiersChecked` (>= 2 kinds, never values) is required with it.

nameAr.description: Arabic test name (1.8.0, optional). Clients fall back to `name`.

preparationAr.description: Arabic preparation instructions (1.8.0, optional). Fall back to `preparation`.

sampleTypeAr.description: Arabic specimen type (1.8.0, optional). Fall back to `sampleType`.

NurseCollection.description: A sample the nurse already collected (KNLAB01). The tube label becomes the specimen barcode; chain of custody starts at `collectedAt`. The consent token is the patient's LAB_RESULTS record-share grant (the lab stores only its SHA-256).

collectorRef.description: Opaque collector reference; never a phone number or national id.

label.description: Tube label / barcode, 3-40 printable ASCII, unique per lab.

ProductAcquisitionBlock.description: Optional acquisition block Kiorex adds to an order or booking it took on its public page (1.12.0; used from package P4-B2). Mirror of the Clinic block: origin, reason, decision and policy references, evidence hash. Can only remove a fee, never add one. A partner that does not know it ignores it. Never patient data.

origin.description: CROSS_PRODUCT (1.13.0): the patient came from another Kiorly product. Treated as MARKETPLACE by a partner that does not know it; it can only remove a fee, never add one.

factRef.description: Optional fact reference (1.13.0). decisionId is used when absent.

CommissionRateView.description: COM-2 (additive, contracts 1.13.0). The organisation's commission rate as Kiorex sets it (default per organisation type, override per organisation, maker-checker, append-only, effective-dated). Read-only on the product side: it only displays it. The effective rate is computed from `history` at read time (reference: effectiveCommissionRate in @kiorex/contracts). No numeric rate is shipped: an empty history is 'rate not set', no commission is charged. No actor identity travels.

orgRef.description: Kiorex's own reference to the organisation: the Clinic tenant id; for Pharmacy and Lab the Kiorex partner registration id. The signed client key (Pharmacy, Lab) or the tenant (Clinic), not this field, addresses the organisation.

version.description: Monotonic; the newest version wins, an equal or older one is ignored.

reminderDays.description: Days relative to the invoice due date (negative = before).

disclosure.description: COM-3 (additive). Provider-facing disclosure texts exactly as the Kiorex super admin entered them (no wording is shipped: empty strings and wordingSet=false mean the text block is hidden). Read only.

counsel.description: COM-3 (additive). Funds-flow counsel status for the organisation's market (NOT_REVIEWED, APPROVED_WITH_CONDITIONS, APPROVED, REJECTED). Read only; informational.
